request.description:
**Automatic Validation:**

PUT [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/{jobId}](http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1)  
**Headers:** Authorization: Bearer {{jwt_token}}

**Body (form-data):**  
data: {  
"budgetMin": 60.00,  
"budgetMax": 150.00  
}

**Expected: 200 OK**  
Response should show:  
\- New budget range  
\- Other fields unchangedEndFragment

---

**Invalid Partial Budget Update (Should FAIL)**  
**Scenario:** Job has budgetMax = 100, try to update budgetMin to 120  
PUT [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1](http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1)  
**Headers:** Authorization: Bearer {{jwt_token}}

**Body (form-data):**  
data: {  
"budgetMin": 120.00  
}

**Expected: 400 BAD REQUEST**  
Error: "Budget minimum (120.00) must be less than maximum (100.00)"

(Partial Update)  
PUT [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/{jobId}](http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1)  
**Headers:** Authorization: Bearer {{jwt_token}}

_Body (form-data):  
_data: {  
"title": "Fix Bathroom Leak - VERY URGENT"  
}

**Expected: 200 OK**  
Response should show:  
\- New title  
\- All other fields unchanged  
\- Existing photos still thereEndFragment

---

PUT http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1  
**Headers:** Authorization: Bearer {{different_user_jwt_token}}  
  
**Body (form-data):**  
data: {  
"title": "Hacked title"  
}  
  
**Expected: 401 UNAUTHORIZED**  
Error: "You cannot update this job"

**DELETE** [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/{jobId}/photos/{photoId}](http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/{jobID}/photos)  
**Headers:** Authorization: Bearer {{jwt_token}} (job owner)

**Expected: 200 OK**  
\- gets the job details with that certain photo deleted

POST [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/{jobID}/photos](http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/{jobID}/photos)  
**Headers:** Authorization: Bearer {{jwt_token}} (job owner)

**Body (form-data):**  
photos: \[photo1.jpg, photo2.jpg, photo3.jpg\] type: file

**Expected: 200 OK**  
Response should show:  
\- All text fields unchanged  
\- New Photo added

---

POST [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/{jobID}/photos](http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/{jobID}/photos)  
**Headers:** Authorization: Bearer {{jwt_token}} (job owner)

**Body (form-data):**  
photos: \[photo1.jpg, photo2.jpg, photo3.jpg, photo4.jpg, photo5.jpg, photo6.jpg\] type: file

**Expected: 400 BAD REQUEST**  
Error: "Maximum 5 photos allowed"

PUT [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/{jobId}](http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/{jobId})  
**Headers:** Authorization: Bearer {{jwt_token}}

**Body (form-data):**  
data: {  
"title": "Urgent Plumbing Repair - Updated",  
"description": "Complete bathroom renovation needed",  
"budgetMin": 80.00,  
"budgetMax": 200.00,  
"urgency": "HIGH",  
"location": "BEIRUT"  
}  
**  
Expected: 200 OK**  
Response should show:  
\- All fields updated

---

**Scenario:** Job status is IN_PROGRESS or COMPLETED

PUT [http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1](http://localhost:8080/api/jobs/1)  
**Headers:** Authorization: Bearer {{jwt_token}}

**Body (form-data):**  
data: {  
"title": "Try to update"  
}

**Expected: 400 BAD REQUEST**  
Error: "Job must be OPEN to be updated"
